hugo_simberg_wounded_angel_20261024_2315.story: A more disciplined 12-shot arc: a direct human gaze, the injured angel, her snowdrops, then full context. Move through the burden of carrying, wings, actual Helsinki shore, return to the boy's gaze, bare feet and final full composition. Genuine details, no repetitive angel crops, no transparent transitions.

scenes.intent: A rear boy looks directly at the viewer with an unforgettable human gaze
The angel's bandaged head and lowered face emerge in quiet contrast
Genuine painted snowdrops become visible in the angel's hand, a tiny note of fragile life
The complete real painting reveals a procession of two boys carrying a wounded angel
The front boy in dark clothing walks with his eyes turned away
The front boy's hand holds the stretcher pole, showing the physical act of carrying
The angel's folded white wings reveal a vulnerability without sensationalizing the injury
The painted grey water and autumn trees anchor the strange event in an ordinary Helsinki landscape
A closer return to the rear boy's questioning eyes after the entire scene is known
Bare feet and the long white fabric mark the angel's helpless weight on the stretcher
The front boy and angel share the frame, making their silent relationship readable
Hold the entire authentic 1903 painting in stillness without inventing a definitive explanation
